intro: Return to Jitters concludes Chef Grual's culinary errand in Duskwood. Having prepared his infamous 'crab' cakes using the gooey legs of the local venom web spiders, Grual sends you back to the starving, terrified hermit at Raven Hill. Delivering the meal finally satisfies Jitters' desperate hunger.

clips.title: Completion

And here, please let me pay you for these!
